title: Pumpkinpalooza Halloween Fundraiser
organizer: Grass Roots Cultural & Performing Arts Center
description: Support the nonprofit Grass Roots Cultural & Performing Arts Center at the Fallout Shelter, 61 Endicott Street. Live music from Girl With a Hawk and Crow Follow, with Blue Ribbon BBQ.

title: A Buck for Sally
organizer: Liam Flanagan’s Scout project · Mustang Sally comfort-dog enclosure
description: Scout Liam Flanagan is raising money for an enclosure at Coakley Middle School for Mustang Sally, the Norwood Police Department’s comfort dog. Read WBZ’s report for the project background.

title: Thanksgiving Pie Sale
description: Order Wilson Farm pies online to support Norwood’s student musicians. Orders are due November 12; pickup is the afternoon of Tuesday, November 24 at Norwood High School.

title: Luminary Night
description: Sponsor a $5 luminary on the Norwood Town Common in honor or memory of someone special. Proceeds support Norwood residents facing serious medical hardship; see the organizer’s announcement for purchasing details.

title: Annual Benefit Luncheon
organizer: Friends of St. Nick · Supporting Dana-Farber Cancer Institute
description: Annual benefit supporting Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, held in the Tiffany Ballroom at the Four Points by Sheraton Norwood. Visit the organizer’s website for the luncheon and use its purchase/donation page to support the fundraiser.

title: Coats for Kids & Families Coat Drive
organizer: Caring Partners · Anton’s Cleaners, Jordan’s Furniture & Rockland Trust
description: Donate gently used winter coats for children and adults. Norwood drop-off: Rockland Trust, 61 Lenox Street. Donated coats are professionally cleaned by Anton’s Cleaners and distributed through local schools and community organizations.
norwood_relevance: Verified Norwood collection location: Rockland Trust, 61 Lenox Street

title: Nonperishable Food Donations
organizer: Ecumenical Community Food Pantry of Norwood
description: Donate nonperishable food at collection boxes inside Stop & Shop or Shaw’s, or at the Pantry Box at 150 Chapel Street (behind Grace Episcopal Church). Pantry drop-off hours are Monday–Friday, 9–11 AM; call ahead to arrange larger donations or a different time.
norwood_relevance: Official ongoing Norwood Food Pantry donation instructions

title: VFW Post 2452 Meat Raffle
description: Open to the public. Established weekly Saturday raffle, 2-5 p.m., during the September-May season.
